component.name: Hexadron Launcher
component.summary: Play Minecraft with mods, modpacks and separate profiles

description.p: A Minecraft launcher that keeps every profile in its own folder, with its own version, loader, mods and worlds.

ul.li: Every Minecraft version, with Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge
Mods, modpacks, resource packs, shaders and data packs from Modrinth and CurseForge
Profiles exported to one file and imported on another computer
Microsoft and offline accounts, skins and capes
A storage window that shows what takes space and frees what nothing uses
The right Java for each version, downloaded when it is missing

description.p: In the Flatpak version the game and its mods can use the launcher's own data folder and your Downloads folder, but not the rest of your home folder.
